description: Investigate and document a bizarre edge case bug in the calculate_discount() function. The function fails for negative discounts, excessive discounts (>100%), and string inputs. Your task: (1) Run the test suite to observe failures (use terminal: python test_pricing.py), (2) Add print statements to utils/pricing.py to trace execution and understand WHY each edge case fails, (3) Add detailed comments in utils/pricing.py explaining the root causes, (4) Create a file named 'edge_case_analysis.md' in the workspace root documenting your findings including: problem description, observed behaviors for each edge case, root cause analysis, and proposed solutions. Focus on understanding and documenting the issues, not fixing them yet.
